text: Bug 2061218 now depends on `2061191, 2061199, 2061213, 2061244`. Its accepted scope keeps Redux serializable and live calendar objects at the platform boundary; Save must avoid source mutation before success, enforce permissions, remain single-flight/stale-session safe, and retain failures for retry. It excludes field UI, source loading, dirty-close confirmation, delete, generic mutation thunks, and persistence beyond the edit transaction. [Task 1]
